header: The RT64 shaders the web page builds: one shader description a line, other mode L and H, color combiner L and H,
flags, in hex. RT64 specializes each one's WGSL when the page is built and builds them with the game waiting: those
above the first "section" line before the game starts, and a section when a frame first wants 4 of its shaders, so
that nothing draws with the ubershader, which integrated graphics can't afford (N64Recomp-browser's README, "Give RT64
a list of the game's shaders").
Recorded by playing: bash tools/record_shaders.sh (its header says how) runs N64Recomp-browser's
tools/record_shaders.mjs with tools/shader_plan.json, which loads the page fresh for each section and goes through the
menus with A, 3.5 s apart, as a player does, once the title is up (Start every 3.5 s through the opening, the
program's "code segment rom 0x00C6C320" line, until the menus' code is back at 0x800E8000 over the opening's). Section
0 is the launcher, the opening (the airship over the stadium), the title and the main menu. Then: match, a singles
match against Luigi on each of the four courts (Hard, Clay, Grass and Composition), 90 s of each on the console's
clock (its VI count) with Mario serving and swinging, A every second, through points, score screens and replays;
tournament, the Mushroom Cup's opening, its bracket and its first match; ringshot, Ring Shot's first game; bowser,
Bowser Stage's lava court with its items; piranha, Piranha Challenge; doubles, a doubles match on the Hard Court
(Mario, Luigi, Baby Mario and Peach); demo, the title's attract demo and its victory scenes. Not recorded: other
characters' and unlocked courts' own combiners, if any, the later cups, the end of a set or a tournament past the time
played, and the main menu's other entries.
